articles.summary: Passkey testing testRigor now supports passkey authentication, allowing users to automate login flows on websites that use passkeys instead of traditional passwords. Users can create passkeys, upload them as global variables, and then link them to specific users on the Authentication tab. For more information, check the documentation page.
